source: Re-grounded against the live src/ tree on 2026-05-04. Verify line ranges with the source-viewer button on each stage card; line numbers drift as code changes.

stages.title: Startup & Runtime Components
stages.tagline: Wire up Prompter, History, ActionManager, ObjectiveStack, MemoryBank, SessionMemory, SelfPrompter, TranscriptLogger, world identity, optional JourneyMap sync.
notes: Agent.start now initializes ActionManager, ObjectiveStack, and a session_memory object BEFORE Prompter (agent.js:63-66), so prompt-time helpers can rely on session state existing. session_memory is then re-initialized after History is built (agent.js:91), which is redundant but harmless.
TranscriptLogger is created right after Prompter so agent.start, agent.disconnect, agent.spawn, agent.login lifecycle events are recorded (agent.js:68-76, 122-129, 144-154, 161-203).

_initializeWorldMemory resolves a world id, loads world-scoped MemoryBank state, and (if settings.auto_sync_journeymap_on_start is true) pulls JourneyMap waypoints from the bridge URL into MemoryBank (agent.js:206-255). Low-confidence world ids surface a warning in chat.
Spawn timeout still comes from settings.spawn_timeout; if the bot fails to spawn the agent exits cleanly after recording lifecycle events (agent.js:155-203).

stages.title: Incoming Chat
stages.tagline: Filter, optionally translate, and route player messages to handleMessage().
notes: respondFunc handles both 'chat' and 'whisper'. Bot-self messages are ignored and settings.only_chat_with still filters configured chatter before any model work (agent.js:294-324).
Open chat only triggers when serverProxy.getNumOtherAgents() === 0 (agent.js:330-334), which avoids multi-bot conflicts but remains easy to miss in docs.

handleEnglishTranslation is still called twice for normal inbound chat: once in respondFunc (agent.js:313) and again at the top of handleMessage (agent.js:461). That is likely redundant translation work.

stages.title: Direct Command Shortcut
stages.tagline: If the player typed a valid !command, parse, validate, execute, render the result, update session memory, and return. No LLM call.
notes: Short-circuits before any model call (agent.js:421-454). Validation, execution, result rendering via renderCommandResult, response routing, transcript end event, then return.

_commandMetadata extracts a resourceTarget for resource-shaped commands (!mineOre, !planMiningRun, !findInStorage, !restockFromStorage, !craftRecipe, !collectBlocks, etc.) so noteCommandStart/Result can update pendingTasks and currentResourceTarget in session_memory (agent.js:257-282, 439-442).
!newAction is still special-cased and DOES add the message to history before execution so generated code has the user's context (agent.js:434-438).
Forced user commands save history when !newAction runs or when MemoryBank is dirty, which matters for JourneyMap/storage/route imports (agent.js:445-447).

stages.title: History & Session-Memory Update
stages.tagline: Add the new turn to History (player→user, system→system, bot→assistant), update session_memory pending tasks from the user message, and persist.
notes: OpenAI-style role mapping. Behavior logs from modes are inserted as system messages BEFORE the user request (agent.js:475-483). Mode behavior log is truncated at MAX_LOG=500 chars.

noteUserIntent runs on real user messages (agent.js:469-471): it scans for ore/resource references via extractRequestedResourceTargets and upserts a pendingTasks entry like {kind: 'mine', item: 'iron_ore', status: 'pending'}, capped at 8 entries.

History.add does not save by itself; handleMessage persists after the inbound turn (agent.js:486-487) and after each response-loop iteration (agent.js:588). Forced commands save only for !newAction or dirty MemoryBank.

When turns exceed settings.max_messages, an older chunk is split off, filtered for durable memory by _filterTurnsForMemory, queued for summarization, and archived to bots/{name}/histories/ (history.js:79-109, 149-174).

stages.title: Prompt Preparation
stages.tagline: Fill the conversing template via replaceStrings: $NAME, $STATS, $INVENTORY, $COMMAND_DOCS, $EXAMPLES, $TEXT_MEMORY/$STRUCTURED_MEMORY/$MEMORY (now includes session memory + MemoryBank summary), $CONVO, $LAST_GOALS, …
notes: $STATS aggregates stats + entities + nearbyBlocks. $STATS, $INVENTORY, and $EXAMPLES are cached across promptConvo retry attempts via stableReplacements (prompter.js:281-360), but not across separate response-loop turns.

$MEMORY now combines three sources: History.memory (text summary), formatSessionMemory(sessionMemory), and memory_bank.getPromptSummary(context). The session line looks like 'Current session: objective=#7 mineOre(...); pending=mine:iron_ore; last_failure=ENTITY_NOT_FOUND; next=!followPlayer("Player")' (session_memory.js:161-179).
$STRUCTURED_MEMORY is a separate placeholder that emits the structured part only — useful for prompts where the text summary is not wanted (prompter.js:208-214).
Example retrieval uses latestIntentText() + assistant-output overlap + a small user-intent role boost to focus retrieval on the latest request (examples.js:24-90).

promptMemSaving explicitly disables the structured-memory expansion via options.includeStructuredMemory=false so the saving prompt does not see the memory it is being asked to produce (prompter.js:434-437).
$BLUEPRINTS is only replaced when agent.npc.constructions exists (prompter.js:247-255); otherwise the unknown-placeholder warning can still fire if a profile includes it without constructions.

stages.title: LLM Request
stages.tagline: Send prepared prompt to the chat model. Cooldowns, retries (3x), staleness checks, sanitation.
notes: Cooldown via checkCooldown (prompter.js:273-279), 3 retries (prompter.js:286), drops stale responses if a newer user message arrived (prompter.js:288-289, 341-349).
Strips </think> reasoning prefixes (prompter.js:351-354) and filters hallucinated '(FROM OTHER BOT)' mentions (prompter.js:331-339).
Returns empty string on exhaustion — caller treats empty as 'stop the loop' (prompter.js:359 / agent.js:498-504).

stages.title: LLM Response Handling
stages.tagline: Empty means stop. Chat replies are routed. Command replies are extracted, executed serially, fed back as system turns, and session memory is updated per command.
notes: extractCommandMessages finds every command in a model response and handleMessage executes them in source order (agent.js:506-577); the old first-command truncation behavior is gone.

Each executed command is bracketed with noteCommandStart / noteCommandResult so session_memory tracks lastCommand, currentResourceTarget, lastCommandResultCode, lastFailureReason, and nextRecommendedRecoveryCommand from result.next_hints (agent.js:561-564, session_memory.js:117-149).
Invalid commands add a rendered ERR_COMMAND_MISSING system result, mark it in session_memory, and the loop continues to any later queued command (agent.js:516-533).

max_responses is resolved by resolveMaxResponses() (agent.js:38-54): explicit caller overrides win, normal user messages cap at 1, and self-prompts with active objectives can use settings.max_commands.

stages.title: Command Execution
stages.tagline: Dispatch to commands/{actions,queries}.js, record transcript events, normalize the return into {ok, code, summary, data, next_hints, raw}, render to the prompt-facing string.
notes: Strict argument validation remains: name, count, type, domain checks, and item/block existence checks (commands/index.js:118-195).

Every command return is funneled through normalizeCommandResult, which accepts already-normalized objects, legacy {ok/reason/message} objects, or raw strings, and stamps stable codes (OK / ERR_BAD_FORMAT / ERR_BAD_ARGS / ERR_COMMAND_MISSING / ERR_EMPTY_RESULT / ERR_EXCEPTION / ERR_PARTIAL / ERR_INTERRUPTED / domain-specific ERR_*) (commands/index.js:33-323).

renderCommandResult preserves the legacy 'OK:'/'FAILED:' prefix shape but rewrites it to the stable code, so prompt-facing output now reads e.g. 'ERR_NO_PATH: Could not reach target' (commands/index.js:325-338).

Transcript command results are capped at 4000 chars via _truncateTranscriptValue (commands/index.js:402-415); prompt-facing command output is still mostly the rendered command text, so individual commands still need concise outputs.

stages.title: Reasoning & Re-Prompt Loop
stages.tagline: After each command, append rendered result as a system turn and prompt the model again. Capped by resolveMaxResponses; ERR_EMPTY_RESULT bails out of the inner loop.
notes: The for loop in handleMessage at agent.js:491 is the reasoning loop; the inner loop at agent.js:512-577 handles multiple commands emitted by one model response.

resolveMaxResponses (agent.js:38-54) makes response caps goal-aware: self-prompts with an objective whose status is in {running, in_progress, pending} can use the configured max_commands; otherwise the cap is min(configured, 1).

There is still no explicit reflection step. The model gets the rendered command result as a system turn and must infer recovery from the ERR_* code unless the command provided next_hints (which are now also surfaced to session_memory.nextRecommendedRecoveryCommand).

stages.title: Modes & Autonomous Follow-Up
stages.tagline: 300ms serialized async tick: update modes, run self-prompter, check task done. Death/idle/disconnect events feed back into handleMessage.
notes: 300ms tick is implemented as a serialized async loop rather than setInterval (agent.js:730-743), so update() calls do not overlap if one tick runs long.
Death event grabs the position into MemoryBank.places('last_death_position') and triggers handleMessage with a death system prompt (agent.js:703-715).
Self-prompt loop stops after MAX_NO_COMMAND=3 consecutive empty responses (self_prompter.js:64-77).

stages.title: Memory System
stages.tagline: History.turns + 500-char History.memory summary, typed MemoryBank namespaces, ObjectiveStack, plus per-session SessionMemory and TranscriptLogger.
notes: History.memory is still hard-capped at 500 chars (history.js:67-70), now with timeout/requeue behavior around summarization failures.

MemoryBank stores typed namespaces: places, journeymap.waypoints, routes, storage, observations, pending. mining_objective.recordMiningCompletion writes to storage/home_chest counts and observations on every successful mine — so MemoryBank is now also a write target from objective code, not only places (memory_bank.js:1-260, mining_objective.js:1-40).

SessionMemory is the new short-lived layer: per-handleMessage state (active objective, current command, current resource target, pending tasks, last result code, last failure reason, next recommended recovery, last surfaced memory labels) that gets formatted into $MEMORY (session_memory.js:1-180).
ObjectiveStack push/pop/updateTop/clear all call noteObjectiveUpdate so session_memory.activeObjectiveSummary stays in sync without an explicit prompter call (objective_stack.js:23-62).
TranscriptLogger covers chat/model/command/memory/lifecycle/objective events and is enough scaffolding for replay/eval work (transcript_logger.js:1-120).

stages.title: Why Tool Output Quality Matters
stages.tagline: Command output text becomes the next system turn AND mutates session memory — it directly steers the next decision and the next prompt.
notes: Command outputs go through normalizeCommandResult → renderCommandResult with stable OK/ERR_* prefixes. result.next_hints (and the legacy recommendedCommands) flow into session_memory.nextRecommendedRecoveryCommand and become part of the next $MEMORY block.

ActionManager.getBotOutputSummary keeps both the first and final ~250 chars of bot output for long logs (action_manager.js:187-201); the remaining gap is preserving structured failure detail (code, summary, tail, next_hints) in only ~500 chars when ActionManager output is wrapped into a command result.

Transcript logging caps oversized command results at 4000 chars (commands/index.js MAX_TRANSCRIPT_RESULT_CHARS), but prompt-facing command result still depends on each command/action keeping its output concise.

stages.title: Multi-Model Layer / Prompter Internals
stages.tagline: Prompter routes promptConvo / promptCoding / promptNewActionPlan / promptMemSaving / promptShouldRespondToBot / promptVision to per-profile chat/code/vision/embedding models.
notes: _model_map.js auto-loads every adapter in src/models/ at import time and infers the API from the model name prefix or known substrings ('gpt'/'o1'/'o3' → openai, 'claude' → anthropic, 'gemini' → google, etc.) (models/_model_map.js:10-76).
All adapters expose sendRequest(turns, systemMessage) and sendVisionRequest(...). New providers = new file with a static prefix.

Easy/cheap calls (memory summary, bot-responder, new-action planning) currently use the same chat_model as the main reasoning step. promptNewActionPlan exists as a separate call but routes through chat_model (prompter.js:400-432) — no dynamic routing layer yet.
Embedding model falls back to {api: chat_model_profile.api} with no model name when profile.embedding is missing (prompter.js:80-93). For some providers this silently degrades retrieval quality.

doc_drift: Stage 2: chat only fires when getNumOtherAgents() === 0; multi-bot avoidance is still easy to miss in docs.
Stage 2: handleEnglishTranslation is called twice (event handler + handleMessage), likely a redundant translation cost.

Stage 3: !newAction adds the message to history before executing, breaking the simple 'direct commands skip history' description. _commandMetadata also writes to session_memory so direct commands now mutate prompt-facing state, not just chat.
Stage 4: noteUserIntent runs on every real user message and seeds session_memory.pendingTasks with extracted ore targets. Not yet documented in bot-flow.md.

Stage 5: $MEMORY is no longer just 'the running summary'; it now embeds session_memory (objective, current/last command, pending tasks, last failure, next hint) and memory_bank.getPromptSummary. $STRUCTURED_MEMORY is a separate placeholder. Docs still describe the old single-string memory.
Stage 5: latestIntentText(), assistant-output overlap, and retry-local replacement caching are undocumented details that affect prompt shape and latency.
Stage 7: runtime now executes every command extracted from one model response, while the default prompt and command docs still instruct the model to use at most one command per response.

Stage 8: every command result is normalized to {ok, code, summary, data, next_hints, raw}; renderCommandResult rewrites OK:/FAILED: prefixes to stable codes. Docs still describe free-text command outputs.
Stage 10: the 300ms serialized update loop and mode-update-then-self-prompter ordering aren't called out in the doc.

Stage 11: 500-char History.memory truncation is enforced in code, but MemoryBank now stores typed namespaces and is written by objective code (mining_objective.recordMiningCompletion writes storage + observations on every successful mine). Docs only describe the prose summary.
Stage 11: SessionMemory is a new short-lived prompt-time memory layer between History.memory and MemoryBank. Not in bot-flow.md.
Stage 12: command results now get OK/ERR_* normalization and next_hints, but prompt-facing output still has no global renderer-side size budget.
Stage 13: Prompter also owns promptCoding, promptNewActionPlan, promptShouldRespondToBot, and promptVision; the doc only highlights conversation prompting and memory-saving.
